_comment: TAP-10 v1.1 'Test Cases / Access layer' as written by the official text, nothing added. Counting basis: 16 table rows, expanded to 27 cases (one per input; a row with several inputs shares one expected result). 'expected' holds only what the TAP says; 'needsChain' marks cases (or parts of a case) that need on-chain state a fake chain cannot honestly reproduce. 官方 TAP-10 v1.1 Test Cases（访问层）原文；16 行展开为 27 个用例（每个输入一例，同一行的多个输入共享期望）。不含任何自拟期望值。
